content:
It's time to check out the latest iPhone 18 Pro phone case recommendations. Apple's newest model began accepting pre-orders this morning, with products from several well-known brands also ready to go. Apple has launched a series of perfectly colour-coordinated silicone and TechWoven styles, along with the trusted third-party favourite brands they've used for years. Highlights include brand-new burgundy styles with built-in stands, ultra-grippy customisable models, and premium leather cases from brands like Nomad and Burton Goods. There are also ultra-affordable options starting from $14 from budget brands like Spigen.

Best iPhone 18 Pro phone cases

Updating…

Special Recommendation: ESR

The all-new ESR iPhone 18 Pro cases and accessories collection has officially arrived, featuring premium colour coordination, patented technology, and other highlights. This new lineup centres around the latest Atelier Vegan Leather magnetic case, equipped with a built-in zinc-alloy Flex Stand and camera platform protection, offering 3x military-grade protection and "a soft, flexible feel that's comfortable to hold." The new Atelier, like the other accessories, comes in four colour-matching options, perfectly complementing the new Burgundy, Glacial, Black, and Silver iPhone 18 Pro models.

  • ESR Atelier Vegan Leather Magnetic Case with Flex Stand $42 (was $46) | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR UltraFit Armorite Pro Screen Protector $30 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Cyber FlickLock Magnetic Case $21 | Amazon or ESR
  • ESR Geo Magnetic Wallet with Stand (with Grip) $46 (was $50) | Amazon or ESR

Nomad

Nomad is arguably one of the top brands in the leather phone case industry, with all their best models now ready and available for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. This year, they've also introduced a brand-new Rugged Case series, with each colour featuring a map texture of Baja California:

  • Rugged Case $70
  • Colours: Norte, Balandra, Arroyo
  • Clear Leather $69
  • Colours: Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black
  • Magnetic Leather Back $59
  • Colours: Burgundy, Saddle, Rustic Brown, Black, Olde Dublin
  • Sport Case $55
  • Colours: Black, Driftwood, Rosewood, Lunar Gray
  • Modern Leather Case $69 – $89
  • Traditional Leather Case $79 – $99
  • Rugged Leather Case $79
  • Colour: Rustic Brown

Special Recommendation: Dbrand

Dbrand is ready to launch their proven Grip case for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max. Beyond having one of the cleanest designs on the market and an ultra-grippy feel, it's once again compatible with a wide range of customisable skin designs, and the compatible Prism screen protectors purchased with the new case come with a discount.

  • Dbrand Grip Case iPhone 18 Pro/Max $55 Customisable case, drop protection, ultra-grippy, tactile buttons
  • Dbrand Prism 2.0 for iPhone 18 Pro/Max 2-Pack $35 ($5 off with case purchase) Easy install, auto-alignment, zero dust

This year, Dbrand is also launching the all-new MNML brand phone case for the first time, starting from $39, featuring ultra-clean aesthetics, lower pricing, MagSafe functionality, and the same crisp button feel everyone loves from the brand.

  • Dbrand MNML iPhone 18 Pro/Max Case $39 Black, Navy Blue, Tan, Burgundy

The 2026 Arc Pulse aerospace-grade metal bumper case has officially launched, with new colours this year to match Apple's Glacial and Burgundy devices:

  • Matte Black – $69.99
  • Polished Silver – $89.99

MUJJO Troubadour

  • iPhone 18 Series All-Leather Case $59
  • Colours: Black, Basalt, Obsidian Green, Tan, Terracotta
  • iPhone 18 Series Modular Case $59
  • Detachable magnetic back panel lets you switch between two modes. With panel attached: Full-grain leather case, slim and MagSafe compatible

Burton Goods

***Note: Use our exclusive promo code 9TO520 at checkout on the cases below for an additional 20% off the already discounted launch price. If it doesn't work, try the promo code DUO10.

  • Heritage Leather Case iPhone 18 Pro/Max $60 (was $80)
  • Luxury Pocket Book Wallet Case iPhone 18 Pro/Max $89 (was $119)
  • Heritage Leather Case iPhone 18 Duo $60 (was $80)

UAG

UAG has also launched a range of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, including their signature rugged designs with thick corner protection, grippy frames, and plenty of drop-protection-focused features. If you want a case built for rough use and everyday protection, UAG's lineup is well worth a look.

  • UAG Mouve $65 for iPhone Duo
  • EGO TACTICAL UAG Urban Armor Gear Pathfinder Case $80 for iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max
  • UAG Civilian Anti-Slip Case from $60
  • And more…

YETI iPhone 18 Pro/18 Pro Max Cases

If you want a rugged case for your new iPhone but don't want to go with the usual OtterBox or UAG options, consider YETI's LoadOut series. These cases pass MIL-STD-810H drop tests, provide reliable protection, support MagSafe, and feature a built-in rotating stand for hands-free use.

Mous

If you want a more premium but not too bulky case for your iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max, don't miss Mous. They now have ultra-thin Aramid Fibre cases available for the iPhone 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, along with the other recommended models below.

  • Mous Limitless MagSafe Case $75
  • Mous Clear Case $70
  • Mous Limitless Aramid Fibre Case $85
  • Mous Thin MagSafe Case $55
  • Mous Thin Aramid Fibre Case $70
  • And more…

Aulumu

AULUMU's iPhone 18 Pro cases offer a more design-forward approach, with futuristic styling, slim profiles, and textured finishes that stand out among typical cases.

  • Aulumu A18 Ultra-Thin Aramid Fiber Case $66
  • Aulumu A18 Pro Drop-Resistant Case $60 for iPhone 18 Pro
  • Aulumu A18 Frosted Case $40

Pitaka

PITAKA cases are perfect for those who want a slimmer feel for their iPhone 18 Pro or Pro Max. Their cases typically use lightweight Aramid Fiber, offer a clean minimalist look, maintain MagSafe compatibility, and add extra protection around the camera and edges.

  • Pitaka Edge Aramid Fibre Woven Case $60
  • Pitaka Summa Military-Grade Drop-Resistant Aramid Case $80
  • Pitaka Cairn Rugged Protection Case $60

OtterBox iPhone 18 Pro Series Cases

OtterBox also offers a wide selection of cases for the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, ranging from slim everyday styles to more rugged and durable designs that provide solid protection. Many newer models support MagSafe, while some styles add grippy edges, accessory holders, raised camera protection, and built-in stands, so you can choose based on your preferred thickness and level of protection.

  • OtterBox Defender Series Pro $70
  • OtterBox Commuter Series $50
  • OtterBox Symmetry Series with Stand $60
  • OtterBox Sole Series $60
  • And more…

Belkin

If you want a cleaner, lighter case for your iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max compared to a full-feature rugged case, Belkin is a solid option. Their lineup typically includes MagSafe-compatible clear and protective cases with raised edges around the screen and camera, while select models (such as Protect+) feature reinforced corners, striking a good balance between everyday protection and slim design.

  • Belkin Clear MagSafe Case $30
  • Belkin Qi2-Compatible MagSafe Case with Grip $50
  • Belkin Protect+ Case with Air Cushion Corners $60
